description: Companion to phase_end_confirm_centered: the rest of the end-of-phase prompt family moved off the bottom edge with it, so the whole flow reads the same wherever the player is in the turn. All three prompts are raised through Main's own show helpers — the call sites this change edited — with representative unit lists, and each is asserted to sit on the viewport centre and to clear the bottom-anchored slot entirely. LIMITATION, stated plainly: none of the three trigger conditions is reproduced here. The unfought-units and battle-shock warnings are driven end-to-end by pad_m1_full_turn_cursor; the Deployment summary's real trigger (Main._on_end_deployment_pressed) is now hard-gated on every unit being placed (#793) and no committed fixture sits in the Deployment phase with a legal, complete deployment, so it is not exercised from the button here.

steps.script:
var d = tree.root.find_child("DeploymentSummaryDialog", true, false)
d.hide()
d.queue_free()
return true

var d = tree.root.find_child("BattleShockConfirmationDialog", true, false)
d.hide()
d.queue_free()
return true
